title: visitors read everything; anything that writes asks them to sign in first

criteria.text: Signed out reads what a signed-in stranger reads: for every Page and post the same fields (location, tags, public posts with body, time, place, photo, counts), compared field by field
criteria.note: [V reread 2026-11-20] built in #1278 (merged 2026-11-12, Reviewed by: a second session, no review-skipped; deploy-health green on def1e35; the migration 20261113000000_visitors_read.sql applied to production 2026-11-12, apply workflow success). The policies a stranger already passes now admit `anon`, and column grants are mirrored, except groups.contact_phone (members-only by default, 2026-10-07). Checked: yes, tests/f134-visitors-read-rest.test.ts [guards F134.1] makes each read as anon and as a signed-in stranger over PostgREST with the publishable key and compares the answers field by field, on rows made through the handlers; seen failing (6 of 7 failed before the migration, and mutants that grant the phone, open a wide post policy or put names back fail it). Smoked: yes, `smoke-live` 2026-11-19 on main 05178ea (routes explore, page, you; personas signedOut, stranger, member, ownerBusiness, operator at 390 and 1280 px; 15 passed, run 44594715209; it checks only that a screen loads with no error and shows no stray email) opened `explore` and `page` as signedOut and as stranger.

criteria.text: Explore and the map are open: signed out, Explore lists Pages and posts as it does signed in (less the personal rows), and the Map pill opens the map with its pins, not sign-in
criteria.note: [V reread 2026-11-20] built in #1278 (merged 2026-11-12, Reviewed by: a second session, no review-skipped; deploy-health green on def1e35; the migration 20261113000000_visitors_read.sql applied to production 2026-11-12, apply workflow success). Explore uses the signed-in loaders minus the personal rows; the map control opens the map signed out (BrowseSurface). Checked: no, only partial markers: `guards F134.2 partial` in src/app/explore/load.test.ts (pins read signed out as signed in; a signed-out search), BrowseSurface.layout.test.tsx (the control opens the map), tests/f134-signed-out-explore.test.tsx (the list carries the post) and tests/f134-visitors-read-rest.test.ts (the database's answer); no one test asserts the whole, filed with 8, 9 and 10 as #1402. Smoked: yes for the list: the 2026-11-19 run opened `/explore` signed out (HTTP 200, no error), which is also the map's address; the pins themselves are not asserted.

criteria.text: Places at their public precision: the exact place or the neighbourhood the owner chose; a signed-out map pin sits at that precision and never closer
criteria.note: [V reread 2026-11-20] built in #1278 (merged 2026-11-12, Reviewed by: a second session, no review-skipped; deploy-health green on def1e35; the migration 20261113000000_visitors_read.sql applied to production 2026-11-12, apply workflow success). Checked: yes, tests/f134-visitors-read-rest.test.ts [guards F134.3] (location precision compared between anon and a signed-in stranger; an area anchor is still an area). Smoked: yes for the Page and Explore screens (same run as 1), the pins' precision is not asserted by it.

criteria.text: Every write asks first: heart, save, get updates, join, Remind me, the Wonder's "I'm in", a neighbour post's answer and report each open the sign-in sheet before anything is saved, and the tap completes after sign-in
criteria.note: [V reread 2026-11-20] built in #1278 (merged 2026-11-12, Reviewed by: a second session, no review-skipped; deploy-health green on def1e35; the migration 20261113000000_visitors_read.sql applied to production 2026-11-12, apply workflow success). A new useSignInFirst hook (heart, save, get updates, join, Remind me, WonderPanel, MemberPostView, ReportControl) opens SignInPrompt signed out, saves nothing, carries `intent=<action>:<id>`, and back signed in only that control finishes the tap, once; post, reply and message have no control a visitor can reach (/create and the composers need an account, requires-account.ts). Checked: yes, tests/f134-writes-ask-first.test.tsx [guards F134.4] taps each control signed out (nothing sent), then signed in via the sheet's address (completes once; a link alone never writes); fails on main before the change. Smoked: unknown, the smoke is read-only and never taps a write.

criteria.text: Following a venue asks in the sign-in sheet and finishes after sign-in
criteria.note: [V reread 2026-11-20] not built: FollowVenueButton (rendered by VenuePublicPage on /p/[...slug]) shows a signed-out visitor a plain link, 'Sign up to get updates from this venue', to /auth/login?next=<path>: no sheet, and the follow is not completed after sign-in. The Issue's own list (#1275 item 14) names venue and member follow. FollowMemberButton has the same shape but its only importer, MemberPublicPage, is not routed (/m/[handle] is retired), so it needs nothing until it is. Filed as #1401.

criteria.text: Enforced in SQL: the REST endpoint with the publishable key returns the public posts with body, starts_at and location, and refuses every insert, update and delete on every member table
criteria.note: [V reread 2026-11-20] built in #1278 (merged 2026-11-12, Reviewed by: a second session, no review-skipped; deploy-health green on def1e35; the migration 20261113000000_visitors_read.sql applied to production 2026-11-12, apply workflow success). anon loses insert, update, delete and truncate on every `public` table, and on future ones through default privileges. Checked: yes, a standing guard: tests/f134-visitors-read-rest.test.ts [guards F134.5] reads the posts as anon, then tries an insert, an update and a delete on every table in the public schema (more than 50) and fails on any the database answers without an error; seen failing before the migration and against a mutant that leaves a write open. Smoked: unknown, the smoke never calls the REST endpoint.

criteria.text: What stays private stays private, in SQL too: the anonymous request gets nothing a signed-in stranger cannot read (no followers-only post, no private group Page contents, no members-only contact field, no legal name, zip, interests or follows, no members row)
criteria.note: [V reread 2026-11-20] built in #1278 (merged 2026-11-12, Reviewed by: a second session, no review-skipped; deploy-health green on def1e35; the migration 20261113000000_visitors_read.sql applied to production 2026-11-12, apply workflow success). Checked: yes, a standing guard: tests/f134-visitors-read-rest.test.ts [guards F134.6] checks that anon reads no unlisted post, no private Page's posts (not through browse_feed either), no phone, no members row; the phone is also held back in the Page component (ShopPublicPage.test.tsx, partial). Seen failing against mutants that grant the phone to anon and open a wide post policy. Stops and service areas now follow their Page's visibility (they were readable for draft and private Pages before). Open elsewhere: a yard-sale post shows its street to visitors as it already does to any signed-in member (the PR asks the PM). Smoked: unknown, not a screen the smoke reads.

criteria.text: Member names stay between members: signed out, a member's display name and avatar do not show (founder, a Wonder's who-is-in list, a member's own post show "a neighbour"), while the counts show
criteria.note: [V reread 2026-11-20] built in #1278 (merged 2026-11-12, Reviewed by: a second session, no review-skipped; deploy-health green on def1e35; the migration 20261113000000_visitors_read.sql applied to production 2026-11-12, apply workflow success). wonder_view, member_posts_read and heart_view answer anon with names and avatars null and counts kept; town_contributors drops first names for anon. Checked: yes, tests/f134-visitors-read-rest.test.ts [guards F134.7]; it fails against a mutant that puts names back. The spelling in the PR is 'a neighbour' while the app says 'neighbor' (the PR asks the PM; #1302 made the spelling American elsewhere). Smoked: unknown.
